name: 玄奘大學慈恩精舍選佛場
selected_version: 2025論文所示整修完工單棟外觀；2025-05-07為啟用事件日，照片原拍日未知，非2026全貌認證
method: Personally viewed all five final 1200×1200 PNGs, not contact-sheet substitutes.
Personally re-viewed seven completed source photographs extracted losslessly from the PDF, plus independent opening-photo-1.jpg.
Read source handoff and prior independent source review; read model README/QA/SOURCES, design-features and feature-validation records.

Independently rehashed STL, colored/editable assets and five PNGs; five PNG bytes/SHA match render manifest, isolated-rebuild report, and front reopen report. This does not claim the reviewer independently reran Blender, exchange editing, slicing or physical printing.

per_view.front: PASS — east/south whole building in frame; low dual-pitch roof, separate black-grid low canopies, east glazing/door/right gray pier, broad entrance steps, south long window and shifted door/ramp retained.
per_view.rear: PASS — west end and north interface readable; two small west louvers, north large flat timber cabinet panels with separate entry break, no invented outer column row or adjacent Kaishan Hall.
per_view.elevation: PASS — shallow east gable/timber top band, left glass/window area, central sliding entrance, right gray pier, stepped entrance. Not a flat-roof box or traditional multi-eave temple.
per_view.top: PASS — continuous long roof ridge and two slopes; lower grid canopies limited to east/south/north, not an invented fourth western wraparound canopy. Northern outer edge is documented display truncation.
per_view.left_oblique: PASS — south window/door/ramp and western solid wall/two small vents, no invented west glass entrance. Whole model in frame.

source_bound_acceptance: North cabinets are large flat timber panels as completed photographs show, not proposal-render full-height dense louvers.
North shared corridor retains roof/grid/floor interface without a fabricated independent outer column row. Excluded neighboring support context is explicit in README and rear/top image alt labels.
Doors partially open are a disclosed presentation approximation, not a claim about exact observed door state.
Glass sheets are real model geometry with rendering/3MF alpha; STL lacks material and transparency. Clear surfaces are not falsely described as empty air.
Model does not include Kaishan Hall, shrine/interior reconstruction, memorial stone, broader terrain or landscaping.
accepted_approximations: No survey scale: all lengths, slopes, step counts, cabinet/rail/grid/window subdivisions and ramp dimensions are photo-proportion estimates.
Small cabinet seams, fine wood grain, title lettering, fixtures and hidden structure omitted/disclosed.
North outer termination is a model-scope cut, not a real freely cantilevering standalone corridor or structural analysis.

manufacturing_limitations.note: Appearance PASS does not supersede actual raw-mesh, global slicing or equipment limits. The stated 0.9 mm sheet is not a whole-model minimum-thickness certificate.

authority: Private local QA only. No main-repository edits or publication.
